text:
Predicates:
Season(x) ::: x is a season.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
LovesSummer(x) ::: x loves summer the most.
Favorite(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
WantsVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WantsVacation(x) → LovesSummer(x)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
Favorite(emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
Favorite(mia, y) → y ≠ summer ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
WantsVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
Favorite(mia, spring) ::: Mia's favorite season is spring.
